interpretation: This is a post-hoc action-profile comparison, not randomized H/X policy assignment.
Utilities are one-season focal payoffs. H catches 2; X catches 6. k counts other seats catching 6.
Only rounds in which all three actions are in {2,6} are included. Seasons have no persistent resource state.
Identical counts k represent exchangeable roles in these commons payoff functions only.
The other ten scenarios have ordinary/nerfed treatment contrasts, not participation curves.
No new model calls or public plays were made.
